edit.description: the five envelope fields and their doc comments become one interface the six mode variants extend, each variant declaring only what is its own

summary: The six `PriorAttempt` variants each respell `key`, `keyedAs`, `declaredAs`, `headSha` and `at` with byte-identical doc comments — the family three plan commit bodies have now accepted as debt
acceptance: the envelope every prior-attempt record carries is one declaration the six mode variants extend, so a field added to it is added once, and `PriorAttempt`'s union, every record writer and every reader are unchanged in what they name
notes: Third body of this family: eeeb7dcc, a74496eb, this one. Verified on disk this tick: `GateRevertAttempt` (`src/Prompt.ts:146`), `CleanExitAttempt` (`:233`), `PlatformPreemptAttempt` (`:302`), `RenderRefusedAttempt` (`:354`), `TipMovedAttempt` (`:417`), `NotShippedAttempt` (`:482`) each carry the same five fields at `:199`-`:220` and its five copies. Claims no property: behavior-free, held by the typecheck and by `PRIOR_ATTEMPT_MODES`. Wants a wave of its own.
